description: Interactive session demo (harness chat --driver scripted --driver-opt script=fixtures/scripted/session-demo.json) in the small web repo of fixtures/scripted/session-demo/README.md. Owner lines, in order: hello / names with spaces around them get extra spaces in the greeting, fix it / yes (typed at the terminal). The agent reads, proposes a contract, writes a failing test (red), fixes the source, runs the tests (green) and calls finish; the gates decide.

turns.text: Hi! I'm sf-harness, a governed coding agent. I can read this repository, explain it, and change it once you approve a contract. What would you like to do?
Let me look at how the greeting is built.
greeting() puts the name in as given, so surrounding spaces stay. Here is the contract for the fix.

input.problem: greeting() keeps spaces around the name, so ' Ada ' is greeted as 'Hello,  Ada ' (src/greeting.ts line 2).

scenarios.when: greeting is called with a name that has spaces around it
scenarios.then: it returns Hello, followed by the name without those spaces

input.commit: fix(greeting): trim spaces around the visitor name

turns.text: Approved. First a failing test for the scenario.
Red, as expected. Now the fix.

input.summary: greeting() trims the name; test/greeting-trim.test.ts went red, then green with the whole suite.
